name: Auto Ping Booster
author: Samee Ullah Feroz

sections.description:
Stop relying on legacy, outdated XML-RPC ping networks that search engines ignore. Auto Ping Booster modernizes your site’s SEO discovery pipeline by dropping dead technologies and utilizing lightning-fast indexing mechanisms.

We’ve expanded our core engine into an All-in-One Indexing & URL Optimization Suite (Yoast-style) to give you total control over how search spiders and human visitors crawl your website content.

⚡ Free Core Features:

  • IndexNow Engine Integration: Instantly ping Bing, Yandex, Seznam, and other supporting crawlers simultaneously with zero performance footprint.
  • Smart State Transitions: Optimized framework fires requests only when status truly changes to publish—protecting your API quotas from draft/typo save spamming.
  • Dynamic XML Sitemap Generator: Automatically creates a high-speed sitemap.xml file mapping your posts, pages, and products for Google and Bing.
  • HTML Visual Sitemap Shortcode: Just drop [apb_html_sitemap] onto any page to instantly display a clean, organized link directory for human visitors.
  • Clean URL Permalink Optimizer: Boost SEO rankings by automatically stripping out clunky stop-words (like is, to, a, me, from, the, and) from your post links upon saving.
  • Virtual Robots.txt Manager: Modify your crawler directives directly from your dashboard without modifying server root files.
  • Webmaster Verification Suite: Easily insert verification meta tags for Google Search Console, Bing, Pinterest, and Baidu.
  • Integrated Visual Activity Logs: Ditch raw text files. Monitor successful pings, pending attempts, and HTTP errors directly inside a readable dashboard logger.

🚀 Upcoming Premium Upgrades:

We are currently building advanced enterprise features to take your automated search traffic further:
1. Google Indexing API Engine (Pro): Bypasses traditional discovery loops by passing URLs directly to Google’s real-time API cluster using secure service accounts.
2. Autonomous AI Schema & Semantic Meta Tier (AI Tier): Deep contextual post analysis automatically generates JSON-LD data structures and optimized snippet content before triggering server indexes.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire auto-ping-booster directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the application inside the native WordPress Plugins control panel.
  3. Access the tailored interface via the APB Pro dash module in your sidebar navigation to access the new tabbed configuration windows.
sections.faq:
How do I display the visual sitemap for human visitors?

Simply create a new page in WordPress, paste the shortcode [apb_html_sitemap] into the content editor, and publish it. The plugin handles the rest.

Where can I find my XML sitemap for Google Search Console?

Once enabled in the “Sitemaps & Robots” tab, your live sitemap will be dynamically accessible at yoursite.com/sitemap.xml.

Does the URL Optimizer change old links?

No. It safely optimizes new links as you write them or when you manually change a post’s slug, preventing unexpected broken links on older published content.
